The Bloom filters were built so that the false-positive rate was **upper bounded by 1/10⁸**.

They held 8-grams from the WebText training set. Before the 8-grams were added, the text was normalized to lower-cased alphanumeric words separated by single spaces. The authors also checked the low false-positive rate empirically: they generated 1 million random strings, and the filter flagged none of them.
